translations.web: The Pharisees therefore said among themselves, “See how you accomplish nothing. Behold, the world has gone after him.”
translations.bsb: Then the Pharisees said to one another, “You can see that this is doing you no good. Look how the whole world has gone after Him!”
translations.kjv: The Pharisees therefore said among themselves, Perceive ye how ye prevail nothing? behold, the world is gone after him.
translations.asv: The Pharisees therefore said among themselves, Behold how ye prevail nothing: lo, the world is gone after him.
